topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the opening framing and overview for the lecture on inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and damage recognition by pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: They detail how the innate immune system detects signs of infection and cellular damage through pattern recognition receptors and their downstream signaling mechanisms.

topics.label: Propagation, cellular recruitment, and systemic consequences of inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the physiological cascade triggered by immune activation, from leukocyte recruitment and antigen drainage to severe systemic manifestations like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the mechanisms that turn off inflammation, repair damaged tissue, and result in chronic inflammatory states such as granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the closing framing and looks forward to the next lecture.
